purpose: Independent study-family validation after code freeze and two independent medically qualified reviewers. No outcome estimates, labels, predicted outputs or assessment results belong here.
leakage_policy: Group by underlying NCT family, including subgroup, final OS, safety and earlier/updated publications. Any overlap with all prior V1/V2/V3 heldouts, development papers and known trial families must block use as new unseen evaluation.
evaluation_not_ready_reasons: Article availability and permitted rights must be checked separately
No frozen complete clinical outcome labels or negative outcomes
No pre-registered metrics/sampling selection bias assessment
developer_exposure_note: Trial identity and some abstract findings were visible during planning. This is a prospective reserved study-family pool, NOT fully blinded data; future high-confidence final validation should use a separately selected independent corpus.
